description: This file defines the DynamicViewEntity class used for declaring dynamic view entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing view representations, adding entity members, aliases, view links, relations, and generating XML configurations for dynamic views.

classes.name: DynamicViewEntity
classes.description: Represents a dynamic view entity allowing definition and XML export of complex entity views, including member entities, aliases, view links, and relations within OFBiz.

methods.name: makeModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates and returns a ModelViewEntity based on the DynamicViewEntity configuration.

methods.name: getViewXml
methods.description: Generates XML string representing the view entity's configuration.

methods.name: getViewElement
methods.description: Constructs and returns an XML Element representing the view entity.

methods.name: getOneRealEntityName
methods.description: Returns the first entity name associated with the member entities.

methods.name: addMemberEntity
methods.description: Adds a member entity with an alias and name to the dynamic view.

methods.name: addAliasAll
methods.description: Adds an alias-all configuration for an entity with optional prefix and excludes.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias with detailed parameters such as field, colAlias, primKey, groupBy, and function.

methods.name: addViewLink
methods.description: Defines a view link (join) between entities with optional conditions.

methods.name: makeViewEntityCondition
methods.description: Constructs a ViewEntityCondition for view link conditions using parameters.
